def clean(df):
    d = df.copy()
    # coerce numeric columns (some values written as text)
    for c in ["bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm", "flipper_length_mm", "body_mass_g", "year"]:
        d[c] = pd.to_numeric(d[c], errors="coerce")
    # normalize sex label variants (FEMALE -> female); leave missing as unknown
    d["sex"] = d["sex"].astype("object").where(d["sex"].notna(), None)
    d["sex"] = d["sex"].apply(lambda v: v.strip().lower() if isinstance(v, str) else v)
    d.loc[~d["sex"].isin(["male", "female"]), "sex"] = None
    # body_mass_g must lie within [2500, 6500] g; out-of-range values are invalid -> drop
    d.loc[~d["body_mass_g"].between(2500, 6500), "body_mass_g"] = pd.NA
    # negative / out-of-range flipper lengths are invalid measurements -> drop those values
    d.loc[~d["flipper_length_mm"].between(170, 235), "flipper_length_mm"] = pd.NA
    d = d.dropna(subset=["body_mass_g"])
    return d

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=["species"])
    g = d.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
